key: e:managing the risks of plant in the workplace
synopsis: The June 2023 edition of the Model Code of Practice “Managing the risks of plant in the workplace” is identified as official explanatory material for the Model WHS Regulations’ powered-mobile-plant requirements [f2258]. The glossary repeats that identification and explicitly places those model requirements in Australia [f15533]. Its broader description of Australia’s plant Code of Practice as official explanatory material is consistent with the chapter’s more specific statement; the supplied facts identify no disagreement or additional acceptance criteria [f15071, f2258, f15533].

relations.note: Both identify the June 2023 Code as official explanatory material for powered-mobile-plant requirements.
The glossary restates the Code’s official explanatory status with less detail.
The specific glossary entry restates explanatory status, adding title, edition, and regulatory scope.
